publish.title: Publish a new version?
publish.intro: The materials or the test of this training changed. Trainees keep seeing the last published version until you publish — as a notified update, or silently for minor fixes.
publish.noDraftInfo: No unpublished changes — publishing re-announces the current content.
publish.kindNotifyHint: Everyone who already completed the training gets an obligation with a deadline and an email.
publish.kindSilentHint: The draft goes live as the next version — nobody is notified, nothing becomes due.
publish.notifyUnavailable: Nobody has taken this training yet — the first version is published silently.
publish.modeRetakeHint: Materials and test again — the passing result also restarts the regular cycle.
publish.modeConfirmHint: No test — a recorded confirmation suffices; the regular cycle is unchanged.

error.generic: The file is not a usable SCORM package.
error.not-a-zip: The file is not a readable ZIP archive.
error.no-manifest: No imsmanifest.xml found — this is not a SCORM package.
error.bad-manifest: The package manifest (imsmanifest.xml) is invalid or ambiguous.
error.multi-sco: The package contains several launchable lessons (multi-SCO). BrainGain supports single-lesson packages only — export the course as a single SCO.
error.no-launchable-resource: The manifest names no launchable course.
error.entry-missing: The launch file named by the manifest is missing from the package.
error.entry-not-html: The launch file is not an HTML page — this course cannot run in a browser.
error.unsupported-version: Only SCORM 1.2 and SCORM 2004 are supported.
error.cmi5-not-scorm: This is a cmi5/xAPI package, not SCORM — export it as SCORM 1.2 or 2004 instead.
error.encrypted: Encrypted ZIP archives are not supported.
error.path-traversal: The package contains unsafe file paths and was refused.
error.symlink: The package contains symbolic links and was refused.
error.too-many-entries: The package contains too many files (max 2000).
error.uncompressed-too-large: The package is too large when unpacked (max 500 MB).
error.ratio-suspicious: The package inflates suspiciously and was refused.

usersImport.title: Import Users
usersImport.subtitle: paste rows from Excel or any table — preview, then import
usersImport.instructions: Tab-separated columns Name, Email, Roles, Org Unit (a header row is detected automatically). Roles is a comma- or semicolon-separated list of job-role names; Org Unit is a single unit name. Both are matched case-insensitively, and an unknown name flags the row as an error. If Org Unit is left blank, a new user is placed in the top-level unit.

backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: {count} backup(s) stored on the server · {size} total
backups.notice: A backup contains every record in the system — users (including password hashes and activation tokens), job roles, trainings with their answer keys, sessions, org units, settings (including the SMTP password) and all uploaded material files. It does not contain the TLS private key, which never leaves the server. Treat a downloaded archive as confidential. Restoring replaces ALL current data; the server automatically takes a pre-restore backup first so a wrong restore can be undone.
